{{Top|leg}}
A '''data storage buffer''' was installed in [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd's]] [[Seeker AS-M12 message droid|AS-M12-series messenger droid]]. The buffer was hardwired into the unit and stored a record of the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] launch coordinates. The intention was to allow the droid to return to its home base after delivering its message.<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
